name: Meshezabeel
overview: Meshezabeel is identified in Scripture as an ancestor of Meshullam, highlighting a genealogical line important to the restoration community in Nehemiah's time. He is also noted among those who sealed the covenant, indicating his role in the commitment to God's law and the communal renewal of Israel. Additionally, his descendants, such as Pethahiah, held positions of responsibility, reflecting the ongoing faithfulness and leadership within his family.
